domain_title: Accountability, evidence, risk decisions and lifecycle governance
title: Committee accountability without individual ownership
canonical_definition: Governance bodies exist but no identifiable person is operationally accountable for the system.

conditions: Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit Committee accountability without individual ownership: Governance bodies exist but no identifiable person is operationally accountable for the system.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show unowned tasks, absent business owner, or incidents exposing responsibility confusion?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of Committee accountability without individual ownership, or does it remain unknown?

conditions: Refer verified committee accountability without individual ownership to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 2.1 (PDF p. 28), GOVERN 2.3 (PDF p. 28)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on assigning operational responsibilities and executive responsibility for risk decisions. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where accountability is assigned only to a committee, inbox or undefined shared role. The mechanism can have an operational effect where an incident, decision or orphaned task shows that nobody exercised accountable authority.
potential_consequences: Unowned duties and decisions can remain unresolved after deployment.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether accountability is assigned only to a committee, inbox or undefined shared role. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether an incident, decision or orphaned task shows that nobody exercised accountable authority. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review trace normal work and exceptions to acting owners, record escalation, and exercise cover during absence. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether accountability is assigned only to a committee, inbox or undefined shared role. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether an incident, decision or orphaned task shows that nobody exercised accountable authority. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide trace normal work and exceptions to acting owners, record escalation, and exercise cover during absence. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: Trace normal work and exceptions to acting owners, record escalation, and exercise cover during absence.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether accountability is assigned only to a committee, inbox or undefined shared role, and separately check whether an incident, decision or orphaned task shows that nobody exercised accountable authority. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use trace normal work and exceptions to acting owners, record escalation, and exercise cover during absence. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: A committee can provide review when a specific individual retains operational accountability and acts on decisions.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in F1 alone cannot establish AP-F1 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows committee accountability without individual ownership
Implementation or operating evidence shows committee accountability without individual ownership
Presence or tested absence of committee accountability without individual ownership is unresolved within scope
